summary: Fixed pyproject.toml (setuptools 66 keys, Python >=3.11, explicit packages without orbis/__init__, data globs excluding drafts, templates, version from _version.py, commands:main script, renderers entry points) and MANIFEST.in; __version__ now imported from _version. packaging.md names the group orbis.postal.renderer (singular) but the code, docs/plugins.md and CHANGELOG use orbis.postal.renderers, so I used the plural the code reads.
